_comment: This file is updated daily by the AI agent cron job.

today.heading: What the Art conceals today
today.intro: In many cultures, the new moon is considered a time for planting seeds — both literal and metaphorical. Darkness is not emptiness; it is the womb from which light is born.
today.label: Golden Reverie

moon.label: I. Silent Wheel
moon.heading: Lunar gaze
moon.intro: A lunar day lasts 29.5 Earth days — two weeks of blazing sunlight followed by two weeks of absolute cold. Life on the Moon would mean adapting to extremes, learning to bloom in light and conserve in darkness, like a tulip that knows precisely when to open and when to fold.

shiva.label: II. Ring of Flame
shiva.heading: Flame dance
shiva.intro: In the Shiv Purana, Parvati asks Shiva: 'What is the essence of all the Vedas?' He replies: 'The sound Om. It is the syllable from which all of creation chants itself into existence.'

art.label: III. Golden Rule
art.heading: Canvas light
art.intro: The Japanese concept of 'wabi-sabi' finds beauty in imperfection — the cracked pot, the weathered stone, the fading flower. It teaches that transience is not the enemy of beauty but its essence.

philosophy.label: IV. No Self
philosophy.heading: Being for
philosophy.intro: When Krishna tells Arjuna 'You have the right to work, but never to the fruit of work,' he is describing the end of ego-driven action. Act, but let go of the need to be the hero of your own story.
